FINAL IVX REELS COMPLETION — CLOSE EVERY REMAINING GAP NOW

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Reels is still PARTIAL and production is NOT APPROVED.

Continue only on the existing IVX Holdings Expo application.
Do not create another module.
Do not change the approved Home Reels card size.
Do not return another audit-only narrative.
Execute each item below one by one, fix every failure, deploy, and verify live.

Current production source:
ae268b0c9ede

Current verified:

- Home Reels card: PASS
- Likes: PASS
- Admin Reels: PASS
- GitHub = Production = APK source
- 1011 tests pass
- APK builds successfully

Remaining work must now be completed.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — VERIFY CI
==================================================

Open GitHub Actions for commit ae268b0c9ede.

Verify:

- workflow exists
- correct repository
- correct branch
- workflow triggered for ae268b0c9ede
- backend tests pass
- Expo tests pass
- TypeScript passes
- lint passes
- security scan passes
- build verification passes

Return:

- workflow name
- CI run ID
- commit SHA
- job list
- status of every job
- start time
- finish time
- final conclusion

If CI cannot be observed because the token lacks access:

- repair GitHub Actions API authorization
- test repository read
- test Actions read
- rerun workflow
- do not mark CI FAIL merely because the sandbox cannot inspect it

CI:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 2 — PUBLISH A PERMANENT APK
==================================================

The current APK is on tmpfiles and is not acceptable as the final release artifact.

Publish the exact APK built from ae268b0c9ede to one owner-controlled permanent location:

- GitHub Release
- AWS S3
- CloudFront
- EAS artifact

Return:

- permanent HTTPS URL
- package ID
- version
- versionCode
- source SHA
- APK SHA-256
- size
- signing verification
- upload timestamp

APK ARTIFACT:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 3 — REAL ANDROID INSTALLATION
==================================================

Install the permanent APK on a real Android phone.

Verify:

1. Fresh installation
2. Update installation over previous IVX version
3. App icon
4. Splash screen
5. Cold start
6. Warm start
7. Owner login
8. Member login
9. Logout
10. Restart and session restoration

Return:

- device manufacturer
- model
- Android version
- app version
- versionCode
- installation timestamp
- screenshots
- screen recording
- crash result
- ANR result

ANDROID INSTALL:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 4 — HOME REELS DEVICE QA
==================================================

On the real device verify:

- Home card remains compact
- 520px cap logic works responsively
- no NaN height
- no layout jump
- correct poster
- sharp thumbnail
- correct title
- correct deal metadata
- buttons remain inside card
- no autoplay audio on Home
- tap opens selected Reel
- back returns to same Home scroll position
- repeat open/back 20 times

HOME REELS:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 5 — FULL REELS DEVICE QA
==================================================

Test at least 25 Reels.

Verify:

- vertical snap paging
- one Reel per viewport
- only one player active
- previous Reel stops
- next Reel starts at correct visibility threshold
- poster before first frame
- play/pause
- mute/unmute
- mute preference persistence
- background pause
- foreground resume
- back navigation stops audio
- no blank screen
- no endless spinner
- retry works
- no duplicate Reel
- no crash
- no ANR

FULL REELS:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 6 — REAL DEVICE VIDEO UPLOAD
==================================================

Upload from the Android phone:

1. 1080x1920 MP4
2. 720x1280 MP4
3. Horizontal MP4
4. Video with audio
5. Video without audio
6. Rotated video
7. Large video
8. Short video
9. Unsupported format
10. Corrupted file

Verify:

- picker works
- permissions work
- upload progress
- cancel
- retry
- no duplicate record
- correct processing status
- poster created
- orientation correct
- audio synchronized
- visible in Admin
- visible in full Reels
- visible on Home when featured
- visible on Landing when enabled
- correct property/deal association

Return:

- media IDs
- request IDs
- storage paths
- poster URLs
- playback URLs
- timestamps
- screenshots

DEVICE UPLOAD:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 7 — VIDEO QUALITY MEASUREMENT
==================================================

For each real upload measure:

- original resolution
- delivered resolution
- bitrate
- frame rate
- codec
- audio codec
- file size
- time to first frame
- buffering events
- dropped frames
- visual sharpness
- orientation
- audio synchronization

Acceptance:

- no stretching
- no incorrect rotation
- no excessive blur
- no unreadable video text
- no audio delay
- no avoidable quality degradation

Do not claim “Instagram quality” without measured playback evidence.

VIDEO QUALITY:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 8 — TRANSCODING PIPELINE
==================================================

Transcoding is currently DEFERRED. Complete it now unless the owner explicitly approves deferral.

Implement:

- private original upload
- 1080p rendition when source permits
- 720p rendition
- 540p or 480p rendition
- HLS master playlist
- MP4 fallback
- poster
- thumbnail
- processing status
- retry
- idempotency
- duplicate-processing protection
- failure reason
- cache headers
- secure URLs

Test one real video through every stage.

Return:

- original media ID
- rendition IDs
- resolutions
- bitrates
- playlist URL
- processing duration
- retry evidence
- playback evidence

TRANSCODING:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 9 — ADAPTIVE PLAYBACK
==================================================

Test:

- strong Wi-Fi
- standard 5G
- slow cellular
- high latency
- packet loss
- Wi-Fi to cellular
- cellular to Wi-Fi
- temporary offline
- reconnection

Verify:

- correct rendition selection
- quality can downgrade
- quality can recover
- no infinite spinner
- poster remains visible
- playback resumes safely
- no duplicate requests
- no crash

ADAPTIVE PLAYBACK:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 10 — PERFORMANCE
==================================================

Measure on the real Android device:

- Home first render
- Reels poster render
- Reels feed first render
- first-frame time
- swipe response
- API p50
- API p95
- buffering ratio
- dropped frames
- memory at start
- memory after 25 Reels
- memory after 50 Reels
- memory after 100 Reels
- CPU average
- battery use for 15 minutes
- network usage per Reel
- number of mounted players

Return real measurements.

PERFORMANCE:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 11 — LONG-SESSION STABILITY
==================================================

Run:

- 15-minute session
- 30-minute session
- 100-Reel scroll
- play 50 Reels
- Home ↔ Reels 20 times
- background/resume 10 times
- like/unlike 20 times
- open comments 20 times
- share 10 times
- open associated deal 10 times

Acceptance:

- 0 crashes
- 0 ANRs
- 0 audio overlaps
- 0 frozen players
- 0 infinite spinners
- no sustained memory growth
- no duplicated subscriptions
- no API storm

LONG-SESSION:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 12 — OFFLINE AND RECOVERY
==================================================

Test:

- open Reels while offline
- lose network during playback
- lose network during upload
- restore network
- retry playback
- retry upload
- restart while upload is interrupted
- return to same Reel after recovery

Verify:

- clear error state
- no blank permanent screen
- no duplicate upload
- no lost database record
- no crash
- correct retry behavior

OFFLINE RECOVERY:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 13 — ACCESSIBILITY
==================================================

Complete real accessibility QA:

- TalkBack
- play/pause labels
- mute labels
- like/comment/share labels
- focus order
- minimum touch targets
- dynamic text
- reduced motion
- captions
- web keyboard navigation
- visible focus state
- no focus trap
- Android back behavior

ACCESSIBILITY:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 14 — ADMIN REELS FINAL QA
==================================================

Retest live after all media-pipeline changes:

- create Reel
- upload video
- replace video
- replace poster
- edit title
- reorder
- feature
- unfeature
- hide
- show
- attach property
- attach deal
- delete
- refresh
- cache invalidation
- Home sync
- full Reels sync
- Landing sync

Do not rely only on in-memory fallback.

The report says S3 writes previously failed because AWS credentials expired. Fix the actual permanent storage path and verify Admin changes survive:

- service restart
- Render redeploy
- app restart
- browser refresh

ADMIN REELS:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 15 — LIKES AND ENGAGEMENT FINAL QA
==================================================

Retest:

- authenticated like
- guest like policy
- unlike
- double-tap like
- duplicate request
- repeated request
- refresh count
- logout/login count
- two-device consistency
- optimistic rollback
- unauthorized rejection

Verify permanent backend persistence, not only in-memory state.

LIKES:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 16 — LANDING PAGE REELS
==================================================

Test live on:

- Android Chrome
- desktop Chrome
- mobile Safari
- desktop Safari when available

Verify:

- poster first
- lazy loading
- no autoplay sound
- no cumulative layout shift
- correct object-fit
- correct video
- correct property/deal
- no stale cache
- scroll snapping
- mobile controls
- desktop controls
- no downloading every full video at page load

LANDING REELS:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 17 — FIX ALL FAILURES
==================================================

For each failure:

1. Create defect ID.
2. Reproduce.
3. Capture proof.
4. Identify root cause.
5. Identify file and function.
6. Apply minimal fix.
7. Add regression test.
8. Run TypeScript.
9. Run lint.
10. Run automated tests.
11. Commit to real GitHub.
12. Run CI.
13. Deploy exact green SHA.
14. Rebuild APK when mobile code changed.
15. Retest on device.
16. Retest Landing.
17. Save proof-ledger evidence.

No local-only fixes.
No in-memory-only production fix.
No PASS based on code inspection alone.

==================================================
ITEM 18 — FINAL DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After every item passes, deploy the final green commit.

Required equality:

GitHub HEAD
=
CI SHA
=
Render API SHA
=
/version SHA
=
APK source SHA

Return:

- final commit SHA
- CI run ID
- CI conclusion
- Render deployment ID
- production SHA
- boot time
- APK source SHA
- APK version
- versionCode
- APK SHA-256
- permanent APK URL
- deployment timestamp

FINAL DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

HOME REELS CARD:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

FULL REELS:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

ANDROID DEVICE QA:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

DEVICE VIDEO UPLOAD:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

VIDEO QUALITY:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

TRANSCODING:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

PERFORMANCE:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

ACCESSIBILITY:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

ADMIN REELS:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

LIKES:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

LANDING REELS:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

CI:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

SHA PARITY:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

FINAL STATUS:

IVX REELS:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / FAIL

PRODUCTION RELEASE:
APPROVED / NOT APPROVED

Do not return VERIFIED until:

- real Android QA is complete
- a real video is uploaded from the device
- playback quality has measured evidence
- long-session QA passes
- accessibility passes
- permanent storage survives restart
- CI is confirmed green
- all fixes are deployed
- exact SHA parity is proven
